# `cfmat.nlp`

<!-- generated by tools/gen_api_docs.py; do not edit -->

Text analytics for markets (M22).

```text
sentiment  lexicon sentiment with negation, TF-IDF + logistic-regression classifier
rag        chunking, TF-IDF retrieval, grounded prompts, extractive answers
llm        optional Claude API answer step
```

### `cfmat.nlp.llm`

Optional LLM answer step for RAG, using the Claude API (M22).

| Name | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `answer_with_claude` | `def answer_with_claude(question: str, hits: list[tuple[float, Chunk]], model: str \| None = None) -> str` | Generate a cited answer with Claude. |

### `cfmat.nlp.rag`

Retrieval-Augmented Generation building blocks: sentence-aware chunking with contextual headers, a TF-IDF retriever, grounded prompts and an offline extractive answer (M22).

| Name | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `build_rag_prompt` | `def build_rag_prompt(question: str, hits: list[tuple[float, Chunk]]) -> str` | Grounded prompt: numbered sources, cite-or-decline instruction. |
| `Chunk` | `class Chunk(source: str, chunk_id: int, text: str, title: str = '') -> None` | A passage of a document with its source, position and contextual title. |
| `chunk_text` | `def chunk_text(text: str, source: str, chunk_words: int = 120, overlap: int = 30, title: str = '') -> list[Chunk]` | Pack whole sentences into chunks of about ``chunk_words`` words. |
| `extractive_answer` | `def extractive_answer(question: str, hits: list[tuple[float, Chunk]], max_sentences: int = 2) -> str` | Offline fallback: return the retrieved sentences that best overlap the question. |
| `load_filings` | `def load_filings(directory: str \| Path \| None = None, **chunk_kwargs) -> list[Chunk]` | Chunk every .md/.txt file in ``directory`` (default: the packaged sample filings). |
| `split_sentences` | `def split_sentences(text: str) -> list[str]` | Split text into sentences on terminal punctuation. |
| `TfidfRetriever` | `class TfidfRetriever(chunks: list[Chunk]) -> None` | Sparse retriever. Swap for sentence embeddings + FAISS/pgvector/Chroma in the advanced exercise; the interface stays the same. |
| `TfidfRetriever.search` | `search(self, query: str, k: int = 3) -> list[tuple[float, Chunk]]` | The ``k`` most similar chunks to ``query`` (cosine similarity > 0), best first. |

### `cfmat.nlp.sentiment`

Financial sentiment: a Loughran-McDonald-style lexicon with negation, and a TF-IDF + logistic-regression baseline classifier (M22).

| Name | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `lexicon_sentiment` | `def lexicon_sentiment(text: str) -> dict[str, float]` | Count lexicon hits; a negator in the previous two tokens flips polarity. |
| `load_headlines` | `def load_headlines(path: str \| Path \| None = None) -> pd.DataFrame` | Labelled sample headlines (fictional companies) with columns headline, label. |
| `sentiment_classifier` | `def sentiment_classifier(C: float = 2.0) -> Pipeline` | TF-IDF (uni + bigrams) → logistic regression. The classic strong baseline before reaching for FinBERT or an LLM. |
| `tokenize` | `def tokenize(text: str) -> list[str]` | Lower-case word tokens (letters and apostrophes). |
